cohort: The study included 15 atopic wheezing infants, 15 non-atopic wheezing infants, and 18 foreign body aspiration control infants.
finding: Atopic wheezing infants showed significant differences in bronchial bacterial microbiota composition, including higher abundance of Deinococcota, unidentified bacteria, and Haemophilus, and lower abundance of Actinobacteria, compared to non-atopic wheezing infants.
